# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Verist, please report it privately to:

**[security@verist.dev](mailto:security@verist.dev)**

Please include:

- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fixes (optional)

## Response

We aim to acknowledge reports within 48 hours and provide a resolution timeline within 7 days.

Please do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities.

## Scope

This policy applies to the Verist packages published under `@verist/*` on npm.
